Our method discovers correct object boundaries, but mistakenly separates objects due to incorrect depth matches. 7 APPLICATIONS Segmentation is a starting point for many processes in image manipulation and computer vision. In the following we highlight several applications of our light field segmentation method. 7.1 User-guided Object Segmentation. Like most 2D and video segmentation methods, our method segments the light field into regions of consistent appearance, but not into semantic objects. However with a simple user interface, we can can manually select multiple regions that comprise a single object.
